name: seo-local-audit
summary: Audit local SEO for business identity, NAP, service areas, local intent, location pages, reviews, citations, and local evidence.
inputs: business type, primary locations, and service areas
market, language, target pages, and audit date
approved business records, listings, reviews, citations, analytics, and local research
writes: Home.md review link when review is required
external_reads: approved Google Search Console or GA4 data
approved DataForSEO or SE Ranking data
approved directory, review, or manual observation
approval_gates: provider_availability: run bounded read-only checks against approved integration surfaces; do not reveal secrets or probe arbitrary services
external_read: ask before live provider, maps, listing, review, or directory reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require applicable approval
external_mutation: listings, profiles, reviews, citations, CMS, code, schema, publishing, and production are out of scope
done_when: business type, locations, service areas, market, language, pages, date, and scope are explicit
source status, freshness, and evidence labels are recorded
NAP and business facts are not invented or silently normalized
website facts, first-party records, provider observations, and third-party listings remain distinct
local intent, page fit, review/citation observations, and actions are explicit
no local ranking, map-pack, call, lead, or revenue guarantee is made
durable artifact uses project/client/prospect routing and review frontmatter
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred with an actionable reason
verification: verify unavailable providers produced no fabricated local data
verify paid or credentialed calls had approval
verify no listing, profile, review, citation, CMS, code, schema, publishing, or production mutation occurred
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter and Home review registration when applicable
